title: Measuring Image-Relation Alignment: Reference-Free Evaluation of VLMs and Synthetic Pre-training for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating VLM performance on subsets of object pairs with high size imbalance (bounding box size ratio > 1:5) compared to pairs of similar sizes.
Comparing relation prediction metrics (such as RelCLIPScore) on intersecting object pairs (IoU > 0) versus distant object pairs separated by at least 20% of the image size.
Qualitatively evaluating model confusion when prompted with inverse relation directionalities that are less frequent in training data (e.g., <surfboard, person> instead of <person, surfboard>).
Analyzing the distribution of generated relationship predicates to identify over-representation of coarse, high-frequency relations (e.g., 'with', 'on') versus fine-grained, long-tail relations.
